run_wikipedia_page_extraction: run the script to extract Wikipedia pages from a base folder for a given language using 32 parallel threads
run_sharded_extraction: run the script with a rank argument to process a shard of Wikipedia files across distributed workers
run_extraction_with_debug_logging: run the script with debug logging enabled to print detailed extraction statements for troubleshooting
run_extraction_with_progress_bar: run the script on rank 0 to extract pages with a tqdm progress bar showing completion status
run_extraction_and_save_pickle: run the script to extract Wikipedia pages and save the merged results as a pickle file
